श्रीरामकृपालयादव (पाटलीपुत्र): सर, मैंआपकाआभारीहूंकिआपनेमुझेशून्यकालमेंअपनेसंसदीयक्षेत्रकीकुछसमस्याकीतरफसरकारकाध्यानआकृष्टकरनेकाअवसरप्रदानकियाहै ।

महोदय, अपनेसंसदीयक्षेत्रपाटलिपुत्रकेसंदर्भमेंआपकाऔरआपकेमाध्यमसेसरकारकाध्यानआकृष्टकरवारहाहूंकिपटनामुख्यनहरएवंसभीनिश्रितप्रणालियोंसेबिहारकेपटना, अरवलऔरऔरंगाबादजिलेजुड़ेहुएहैं ।इनमेंबानसागरजलाशयऔररिहन्दडेमद्वारापानीभेजाजाताहै, लेकिननहरकाउतार-चढ़ावठीकनहोनेवजर्जरअवस्थामेंहोनेकेकारणसभीजगहपानीनहींपहुंचपारहाहै, जिससेसिंचाईकार्यप्रभावितहोरहाहैऔरकिसानोंमेंकाफीआक्रोशहै ।यहपूराइलाकाखेतीपरडिपेंडहै ।खेतकीसिंचाईसमुचितरूपसेनहींहोपारहीहैइससेकिसानोंमेंआक्रोशहै ।किसानोंकीस्थितिखराबहै ।बिहारसरकारद्वाराकदवनजलाशयकाप्रस्तावकेन्द्रसरकारकेपासभेजागयाहै ।प्राप्तजानकारीकेअनुसारकदवनजलाशयकाडीपीआरबनानेकाकार्यचलरहाहै ।कदवनजलाशयकानिर्माणहोनेसेबिहारराज्यकेकिसानोंकोसिंचाईहेतुपर्याप्तपानीमिलसकेगा ।

मेराआपकेमाध्यमसेसरकारसेअनुरोधहैकिकदवनजलाशयकानिर्माणकार्यजल्दसेजल्दहोजाए ।इन्द्रपुरीजलाशयसेनिश्रितपटनामुख्यनहरएवंइससेनिश्रितप्रणालियोंकापक्कीकरणकरवानेकाकष्टकरें ।मैंआपकेमाध्यमसेजलशक्तिमंत्रीसेअनुरोधकरनाचाहूंगाकिजोप्रस्तावआपकेपासलम्बितपड़ाहुआहै, उसकीस्वीकृतिअविलम्बप्रदानकरकेपटनामेंहमारेसंसदीयक्षेत्रकाइलाका, खासतौरपरपाली, नौबतपुर, बिक्रमइत्यादि ।अरवलऔरऔरंगाबादकाबहुतबड़ाइलाकाजहांसिंचाईकीसुविधानहींहोनेकीवजहसे, नहरअव्यवस्थितहोनेसेलोगोंकोबहुतकठिनाइयोंकासामनाकरनापड़रहाहै ।इसलिएमैंआपकेमाध्यमसेपुन: जलशक्तिमंत्रीजीसेअनुरोधकरनाचाहूंगा, मैंनेउनसेमिलकरव्यक्तिगतअनुरोधभीकियाथाऔरअबपुन: सदनकेमाध्यमसेआग्रहकरूंगाकियथाशीघ्रकार्रवाईकरेंऔरइसयोजनाकीस्वीकृतिप्रदानकरकेकिसानोंकोसमुचितसहायताप्रदानकरें ।धन्यवाद ।

Title: Regarding OBC reservation in medical colleges in Tamil Nadu. 

*SHRI S. VENKATESAN (MADURAI): Hon. Speaker Sir, Vanakkam. The Notification for National Eligibility and Entrance Test (NEET- PG) for admission to Post Graduate Medical Courses has been issued. There is no reservation provided for Other Backward Classes as per the notification. The Notification says that there is reservation available for OBC only in Central Institutions and not for seats in the State Medical Colleges This is shocking. There are approximately 3600 students belonging to OBC in the country who will be affected due to this notification. Tamil Nadu will be worst affected State due to this as it has so many Medical Colleges. Moreover a large population of OBC people are living in the State of Tamil Nadu. Also 50 per cent reservation is provided to OBC in the State. Because of giving so many medical seats to the Central Pool we are already loosing 23 per cent of reservation in such seats as the Union Government provides only 27 per cent reservation to OBC. Now if this 27 per cent per cent is not also provided, Tamil Nadu will be the State totally loosing its OBC reservation in the Central Pool as against the policy of 50 per cent reservation for OBC being implemented in the State. Several political parties have condemned this notification. But still the Union Government is maintaining silence on this issue. This is a dangerous example. The basis of reservation policy is that people who are not equally placed should not be treated equally. Our Constitution says that those who are not equally placed, socially and educationally, should not be treated in the same way in which others are treated.. Nobody has the right to deny this right which is enshrined in the Constitution of India. But a Department of the Union Government is denying this right. If the Union Government is also admitting this by dubious means as the action of the Government raises several doubts. We doubt that whether it is the beginning of fully scrapping the reservation policy in the country. I therefore urge upon the Union Government through his august House to immediately withdraw this notification . Thank you.

Title: Regarding worker’s problem in BSNL. 

SHRI K. SUDHAKARAN: Thank you very much, Sir. Through the Zero Hour, I would like to express my deep concern about 6000 BSNL workers in Kerala and half a million workers across this country who have been facing serious struggle for existence. 

They have not been paid salaries for the past 10 months. More than 1000 out of 8000 contract workers in Kerala were laid off last February with no benefits. The rest of the workers have been staging a strike with no pay. Those who had earlier been given eight hours of work are now being offered just two hours of work. 

Sir, I allege that this Government has been consistently adopting a policy of undermining the country’s prestigious public sector to help private sector telecom companies. It is clear that the Centre is harassing the workers on behalf of the corporate entities as part of its new employment policy.

Sir, when Government declared a voluntary retirement scheme, within five days more than 60,000 opted for retirement. When permanent employees in BSNL have come to the conclusion that it is not safe enough to stay back, the plight of contract workers is perhaps ‘the less said, the better’.

Most damaged land phones in Kerala are now in a state of disrepair as contract workers including those who were paid directly from the department, are not being paid. BSNL will face further crisis with 80,000 of its 1.65 lakh permanent employees being given the opportunity to retire. 

When the world moves to 5G, not having enough employees will create a situation where the public sector will face destruction. I take this moment to ask the Government whether it is prepared to address the workers’ problems sympathetically and save BSNL as it was.

Title: Need to start new train on Karaikal, Thiruvarur, Thanjavur, Pudukottai and Tiruchipalli railway line. 

SHRI M. SELVARAJ (NAGAPATTINAM): Thank you very much, Sir. Tiruchirappalli-Nagapattinam railway line is one of the historic lines. It was the second line constructed by the British after the Kolkata line. The line was used to connect the Nagapattinam Port with Tharangambadi Port. It covers five districts – Nagapattinam, Thiruvarur, Thanjavur, Pudukottai and Tiruchirappalli. 

The towns, Karaikal, Thiruvarur, Nagapattinam and Velankanni are tourist as well as religious places. The Shrine of Andavar in Nagore and the Velankanni Church are famous pilgrim places. People from all over India visit the places round the year. Nearly one crore people from this area are relying on railways only but the Southern Railway is neglecting this area. 

There is only one train on Nagore-Tiruchirappalli line. There is no other train throughout the day. Since there is a lot of commuters, the line is always overcrowded. The Railways should consider starting more trains on this line. It will earn more revenues to the Railways. 

After the gauge conversion of Thiruvarur-Karaikudi line, only the demo train is plying. Earlier, there were many trains like Kamban Express etc. Now all the trains have been stopped. Please restart the earlier trains. Thank you, Sir.

श्रीमलूकनागर (बिजनौर):अध्यक्षमहोदय, बहुत-बहुतधन्यवाद ।मैंगरीबऔरकिसानोंकेबारेमेंएकमिनटसेपहलेअपनीबातपूरीकरूँगा ।पूरेदेशकेकिसानआजबहुतपरेशानहैं ।मेरेलोकसभाक्षेत्रमेंजोसमस्यासामनेआतीहै, वहपूरेदेशकीसमस्याहै ।जबवेअपनामकानबनातेहैंतोपासकीजोनदीयानहरहै, उसमेंसेउसकोरेतनिकालनेकीइजाजतनहींहै ।जबवहअपनाघरबनाताहैऔरघरबनानेकेलिएअपनेखेतसेभरावकरनेकेलिएमिट्टीखोदकरलाताहैतोउसकीइजाजतनहींहै ।जबवहअपनेखेतकोएकसारकरताहै, लेवलिंगकरताहैतोउसकीभीइजाजतनहींहै ।तमामगुर्जर, जाट, जितनीभीकिसानजातियांहैं, बहुतपरेशानहैं ।दलित, पिछड़ेजितनेभीलोगइससेजुड़ेहुएहैं, बहुतपरेशानहैं ।मैंआपकेमाध्यमसेकहनाचाहताहूँकिप्रदेशसरकारेंइसमेंइंटरफेयरकरकेइसकीइजाजतदें ।बहुत-बहुतधन्यवाद ।
